authorization: Researcher explicitly redirects Lab 008 from increasing finite sizes to formulating and solving a general thermodynamic-limit theory of decoding.
question: What thermodynamic theory describes the undirected zero-field decoding model, and how does the link field alter its logical-defect statistics and correctable region?
scope: Two-dimensional undirected underlying graphs, fixed aspect ratio, signed integer charges observed and binary logical parity. The effective link field h is tunable: h=0 is the undirected model; q=(1+tanh h)/2 gives finite bias; h tending to infinity gives one-way noise. Fix p and h before L tends to infinity. Reference arrows are coordinates. Square and honeycomb claims remain distinct.
frozen_work: critical-point or exponent fits to the existing three-size matrix

competing_hypotheses.positive_interface_cost: A diverging typical gap is accompanied by a size-uniform bound on its lower tail; exponential suppression requires quantitative tail control.
competing_hypotheses.sublinear_correctability: The gap diverges on a sublinear scale and LER vanishes without positive line tension.
competing_hypotheses.persistent_ambiguity: A positive physical probability retains a bounded gap, yielding a nonzero limiting risk lower bound.

existing_data_role: Exploratory constraints and exact local algebra checks only. The existing L7/L9/L11 trends select neither a thermodynamic class nor a rate function.
methods: audit of order of limits and unsupported assumptions
exact two-region gluing with boundary flux retained

acceptance.established: At fixed p, the h deformation is an exact exponential tilt by signed bias current J and activity N. Recordwise gap slope/curvature and the Bayes-risk one-sided cusp are exact conditional-moment identities. Existing L3 rational controls show a nonzero finite-volume |h| cusp with zero algebra failures.
acceptance.target: Control the L dependence of the sector-conditioned joint cumulant-generating functions and the tied-record cusp mass. Finite-volume reflection symmetry alone does not classify field relevance.

acceptance.established: For every graph and observation map, h_L sqrt(E_L)->0 makes the Bayes-risk change vanish; the zero-field cusp is at most sqrt(Ep)/2. For every fixed p>0,h!=0, the complete product current laws separate in TV exponentially, so full-law proximity cannot decide fixed-h thermodynamic response.
acceptance.target: Exploit the physical observation map. For the canonical pure-gradient square bias, reduce fixed-h sector response to unmeasured rough-boundary charge generating functions and seek a size-uniform boundary estimate.

acceptance.established: At fixed physical p, the pure-gradient field is exactly a zero-field p_eff channel with a rough-charge fugacity. The measured factor cancels in sector ratios. A same-Q straight-row family refutes any L-uniform pointwise rough-fugacity bound, but not an averaged sector estimate.
acceptance.target: Prove or disprove an averaged sector-conditioned rough-charge generating-function estimate for the physical record law, with p_eff versus p kept explicit.

acceptance.established: Averaging the boundary-only signed generator predicts asymptotically certain rough parity, whereas the true global logical parity contrast is (1-2p)^L and vanishes. The measured-charge factor cancels recordwise in sector ratios but cannot be removed from the physical record average; Bayes risk uses the Q-wise absolute contrast.
acceptance.target: Bound or counterexample the physical-record absolute sector contrast c^E sum_Q exp[hM(Q)] |F_0(Q)-F_1(Q)|; signed averaging and boundary-only averaging are closed shortcuts.

acceptance.established: The prior physical connected-current and parity-only Peierls bounds imply an explicit square size-uniform lower bound on the exact H12 absolute contrast in strict low-p and high-p sufficient regions for every fixed h. This is a corollary, not a new threshold; the p=.30 moderate-p regime is untouched.
acceptance.target: For fixed finite h outside the certified wedges, seek a physical-record absolute-contrast estimate or admissible counterfamily. Keep the already proved sufficient region separate from any sharp boundary claim.

acceptance.established: A single global Chernoff exponent cannot make the direction-weighted nonbacktracking path transfer summable at p=.30 for any finite h; its exact optimum is the old half-Chernoff value. This is only a failed sufficient method.
acceptance.target: Seek a physical-record H12 estimate or admissible counterfamily by a different route; do not infer a phase from failure of the path bound.

acceptance.established: The actual signed-charge record gives an exact sequential sector-Hellinger chain and two-sided H12 interval. All 18 existing-size controls pass; fair-noise supported prefixes can have conditional affinity one, so a naive per-prefix uniform gap is not general.
acceptance.target: Control the accumulated physical affinity contraction at fixed p=.30 and finite h, or find another direct H12 estimate/counterfamily. Terminal affinity is an exact transform of the existing posterior-gap law, so reanalysis of old gap cohorts is not independent evidence; finite L=3 factors cannot be extrapolated.

acceptance.established: On the canonical square, every measured charge outside the L-vertex cut-adjacent strip depends on edges disjoint from the logical cut. Its entire bulk record is independent of H for all L and fixed-p independent-current bias fields; bulk-only prefixes cannot contract sector affinity. The retained exact L3 initial affinity and four existing-size incidence audits pass.
acceptance.target: Seek a size-uniform estimate or counterfamily for the O(L) cut-adjacent strip charges conditioned on the bulk record. Independence of the bulk alone does not settle their conditional sector information.

acceptance.established: For any partial record containing all bulk charges and charges from strip subset T, the L-|T| unobserved cut activities remain independent Bernoulli(p). Their parity masks the conditional logical polarization by exactly (1-2p)^(L-|T|), giving physical contrast at most |1-2p|^(L-|T|). All 24 retained-L3 subset cells and four existing-size geometry gates pass.
acceptance.target: The full-record p=.30 H12 problem is concentrated in the final cut-adjacent strip information, where the masking bound becomes trivial. Seek a genuinely size-uniform full-strip estimate or counterfamily; do not infer a phase from the partial-record bound.

acceptance.established: With bulk charges hidden, the complete right strip alone has absolute logical contrast at most delta(p,q)^L, where delta=|a^2-b^2-c^2|+2a|b-c|+2bc<1 for a=1-p,b=pq,c=p(1-q). Revealing hidden vertical strip currents supplies the product proof oracle; three retained L3 exact cells and four existing-size geometry gates pass. This is an upper bound on a deliberately incomplete record only.
acceptance.target: The full-record information, if asymptotically useful, must arise from bulk-strip correlations rather than either marginal record alone. Freeze further partial-record refinements and address joint physical H12 directly at fixed p=.30 and finite h.

acceptance.established: A positive-probability public bulk-charge saturation event pins the entire hidden interface; the full strip-charge sum then determines logical parity exactly. This refutes every uniform-in-bulk-record extension of the strip-only erasure bound. Its probability decays exponentially, so it does not classify p=.30.
acceptance.target: Seek an estimate or counterfamily for the PHYSICAL average over typical bulk records at fixed p=.30 and finite h; pointwise conditional strip contraction is closed as a route.

acceptance.established: Complete flux reveals H; one-hot quotienting preserves exact gluing; residual-directed path flips preserve binary support, Q and logical switching. Every such flip has exponentially growing two-sided action distortion at fixed p!=1/2 by the all-zero witness. At p=1/2, an all-size row counterfamily gives the frozen rule inverse multiplicity at least L, so that deterministic map is also not a uniform coupling.
acceptance.target: Return to selector-independent capacity: prove or disprove normalized matching for the restricted opposite-rough-arc root-cycle graph, or obtain an averaged physical posterior-balance estimate. Do not tune another deterministic path order or reuse bounded-distortion residual-path coupling.

claim_boundary: Exact identities and conditional theorems must be separated from unproved assumptions about this lattice. A reformulation is not a solved transition, a line-tension limit, or a new threshold.
completed_analysis: Existing-data role and order-of-limits audit; exact zero-field fixed-p response, conditional gap derivatives and Bayes-risk cusp; universal h_L sqrt(E_L)->0 stability and fixed-h full-law separation; exact planted-gap identity, tail criterion, gluing and cancellation; inherited H12 certified wedges; global-Chernoff method obstruction; physical charge-prefix affinity chain with 18 exact existing-size controls; all-size bulk independence, unrevealed-cut parity masking, strip-only parity erasure, and a rare saturated-bulk JOINT-record counterfamily to pointwise conditional erasure, with geometry and retained exact controls; interface-TV/information bounds and directed-endpoint transport obstructions. No new physical data.

model_clarification.user_confirmed_observation: No preferred edge direction at zero field, but signed integer charge is always retained.
model_clarification.charge_alphabet: Edge current j in {0,+1,-1}; measured charge Q=D_M j in the integers.
model_clarification.activity_term: tau(p,h)=log(2(1-p)cosh(h)/p); holding tau fixed would change p.
model_clarification.reference_invariance: D -> DS, j -> Sj, h -> Sh leaves physical sector weights unchanged.
model_clarification.reflection_symmetry: R_L(p,h)=R_L(p,-h) for a fixed bias pattern; no monotonicity or smoothness assumption.

A rare saturated-bulk event has perfect conditional decoding, so uniform-in-bulk-record strip erasure is false but does not settle the average.
